text: {"assertions":["A 401 storm issue was identified in services/auth/token_refresh.py on 2026-02-19 affecting the token refresh authentication path.","The 401 storm issue only impacted accounts in the five percent rollout bucket.","The root cause was a cache entry that was never invalidated on write in the token refresh logic.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction and was submitted as PR #3576 on branch fix/401-storm-1.","The issue could be reproduced by letting an access token expire mid-session.","The 401 storm manifested as a burst of unauthorized responses appearing in the access log.","After the fix was applied, 32 duplicate rows per day that were previously being written stopped occurring."]}
